title: Advanced Daily Conversation 高级日常对话

articles.title: Advanced Daily Conversation 高级日常对话
articles.summary: Idioms and nuanced expressions for natural, fluent conversation.

sentences.orig: I've been meaning to get in touch with you — how have things been since we last caught up?
sentences.trans: 我一直想联系您——自从上次见面后您过得怎么样？

sentences.orig: It's a bit of a grey area, so I'd rather not speculate without knowing all the facts.
sentences.trans: 这有点模棱两可，在了解全部事实之前，我不愿妄加猜测。

sentences.orig: I'm quite taken aback by the news; I never expected the situation to unfold this way.
sentences.trans: 这个消息让我大吃一惊；我从没料到情况会这样发展。

sentences.orig: Let's agree to disagree on this point and move on to something more productive.
sentences.trans: 让我们在这个问题上求同存异，继续讨论更有建设性的话题吧。

sentences.orig: I've been burning the midnight oil lately, trying to wrap up the project before the deadline.
sentences.trans: 我最近一直在开夜车，想在截止日期前完成这个项目。

sentences.orig: To be perfectly honest, I'm having second thoughts about whether this is the right approach.
sentences.trans: 老实说，我对此方法是否正确开始有所迟疑。

sentences.orig: It goes without saying that we should respect each other's boundaries in any professional relationship.
sentences.trans: 不言而喻，在任何职业关系中我们都应尊重彼此的界限。

sentences.orig: That's easier said than done, especially when you're juggling multiple priorities at once.
sentences.trans: 这说起来容易做起来难，尤其是当你同时处理多项优先事务时。

questions.question: What does "burning the midnight oil" mean?
What does the speaker feel about the approach?
